answer: Bounty-funded Sybil hunting resists fake identities: the network pays a standing reward, drawn from slashed stakes, to any agent that proves an identity is fake. Like quartz veins in timber country, fakes hide in plain sight until a hunter's live work challenge exposes them — a test no script can pass twice. A lone juniper of honest watchers becomes a forest, each paid only when a fake falls. An attacker must outspend not just the network's defenses but every bounty hunter its fakes attract, so each new fake raises the reward for catching it.
